n, coins = map(int, input().split())
values = list(map(int, input().split()))

oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0
totalCuts = 0
differences = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    currentVal = values[i]
    if currentVal % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if oddCount == evenCount:
        nextVal = values[i + 1]
        diff = abs(nextVal - currentVal)
        differences.append(diff)

differences.sort()

for diff in differences:
    if diff <= coins:
        coins -= diff
        totalCuts += 1
    else:
        break

print(totalCuts)
</translated_code>
